description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'DelegatingCatalogExtension' that implements the 'CatalogExtension' interface. It provides default implementations for catalog-related methods by delegating calls to an internal 'delegate' object, facilitating extension and customization within the Spark SQL connector catalog framework.

classes.name: DelegatingCatalogExtension
classes.description: An abstract class implementing CatalogExtension that delegates catalog operations to an internal delegate, allowing for easy extension and customization within Spark SQL's catalog framework.

methods.name: setDelegateCatalog
methods.description: Sets the internal delegate catalog object.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the delegate catalog.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the catalog extension with a name and options (empty implementation).

methods.name: capabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of the catalog by delegating to the delegate cast as a TableCatalog.

methods.name: defaultNamespace
methods.description: Returns the default namespace from the delegate.

methods.name: listTables
methods.description: Lists tables in a namespace via the delegate.

methods.name: loadTable
methods.description: Loads a table by identifier via the delegate.

methods.name: loadTable
methods.description: Loads a table by identifier and timestamp via the delegate.

methods.name: loadTable
methods.description: Loads a table by identifier and version via the delegate.

methods.name: invalidateTable
methods.description: Invalidates a table in the delegate.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the delegate.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a table with schema, partitions, and properties via the delegate.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a table with columns, partitions, and properties via the delegate.

methods.name: alterTable
methods.description: Alters a table with specified changes via the delegate.

methods.name: dropTable
methods.description: Drops a table via the delegate.

methods.name: purgeTable
methods.description: Purges a table via the delegate.

methods.name: renameTable
methods.description: Renames a table via the delegate.

methods.name: listNamespaces
methods.description: Lists all namespaces via the delegate.

methods.name: listNamespaces
methods.description: Lists specific namespace via the delegate.

methods.name: namespaceExists
methods.description: Checks if a namespace exists via the delegate.

methods.name: loadNamespaceMetadata
methods.description: Loads namespace metadata via the delegate.

methods.name: createNamespace
methods.description: Creates a namespace with metadata via the delegate.

methods.name: alterNamespace
methods.description: Alters a namespace via the delegate.

methods.name: dropNamespace
methods.description: Drops a namespace via the delegate.

methods.name: loadFunction
methods.description: Loads a function by identifier via the delegate.

methods.name: listFunctions
methods.description: Lists functions in a namespace via the delegate.

methods.name: functionExists
methods.description: Checks if a function exists via the delegate.
